systems.system: DHIS2 Tracker for HIV client-level data
systems.country_label: DHIS2 Tracker (HIV), National AIDS and STI Control Program
systems.owner: EpiC project (FHI 360, PEPFAR/USAID-funded) with the National AIDS and STI Control Program; hosted on the EpiC cloud server, with a Ministry of Health plan to migrate it to its own server
systems.tiers: 21 PEPFAR-supported HIV treatment sites since 2021, covering 70% of people on treatment; data keyed by data entry clerks from paper registers; rollout to 900+ non-PEPFAR facilities planned

note: The system described is a one-programme patient tracker (HIV), which the typology notes and does not assess, so no fact. The article states that 91% of HIV records in the 21 facilities were transferred from paper registers into Tracker, and refers to a Health Information Systems Strategic Plan and a locally owned Ministry of Health DHIS2 server without describing the aggregate HMIS.
